title: The Orange Split into Smiles
youtube_title: The Orange Split into Smiles | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A smaller piece, fairly given, can still be enough.
summary: At a bakery counter on a soft, busy morning, Remy sees that an orange that could become two smiles will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Remy makes a smaller, even share so Kito is included, and Ms. Okonkwo lets the choice stand without a speech.
